scripts.build:cli: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @flowguard/cli
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @flowguard/cli && npm run build -w @flowguard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @flowguard/web
scripts.test:phase2: npm run build:phase2 -w @flowguard/web && playwright test --config playwright.phase2.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:phase2 && npm run evaluate
